title: Modular Metric Lens system and Figma Variable Delta Library
creator: Maya Chen
project: Console Design System - Rollouts & Cost Views
description:
Background: The Console needs a compact, reusable set of metric components (the 'Metric Lens' system) that support high-density dashboards, rollout state indicators, and cost-focused micro-views. Current component variants are inconsistent across spend explorer, rollouts, and alerting panels, which increases implementation cost and causes visual regressions during model/route rollouts.

Goals:
- Define a modular Metric Lens component family (base card, inline sparkline, micro delta badge, threshold marker) with clear token mappings for spacing, elevation, and color semantics.
- Publish a Figma Variable Delta Library that encodes delta states (positive/negative/neutral/uncertain) and compact density rules so engineers can pull deterministic token values for runtime rendering.
- Ensure accessibility (contrast, focus states) and responsive behavior from 240–1280px.
- Provide rollout affordances: canary/baseline overlays, expected-impact badges, and a compact failure/latency flag.

Key decisions proposed:
- Single source-of-truth tokens: color_delta_positive/color_delta_negative/color_delta_neutral, spacing_micro/spacing_mini, elevation_micro. These will be Figma Variables and exported to tokens repo.
- Metric Lens composability: build from 4 atomic parts (header label, primary metric, micro-sparkline, delta badge). Each part supports a dense and regular layout variant.
- Thresholds will support three visual modes: passive, advisory (yellow/amber), critical (red) and an optional tooltip-driven explanation for rollout state.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Figma library published (file link in attachments) with documented variables + usage page.
2) Token mapping doc with CSS/JSON variable names and examples for mobile/desktop breakpoints.
3) Prototype micro-dashboard containing at least 6 Metric Lens instances showing rollouts, cost deltas, and latency flags.
4) Accessibility checklist passed (AA for text and contrast, keyboard focus, screen-reader labels for delta badges).
5) Hand-off package to ENG including React examples and a minimal component spec (props, states, size variants).

Trade-offs and risks:
- Tight tokenization reduces design flexibility for future widgets but drastically lowers engineering rework.
- Micro density increases cognitive load; will instrument with user testing for first release.
- Rollout overlays add visual complexity; propose optional by-toggle in Console until validated.

Deliverables:
- Figma Variable Delta Library (variables + delta tokens)
- Metric Lens component spec (MD doc)
- Prototype micro-dashboard (Figma interactive & Loom walkthrough)
- Implementation guidance for ENG (props matrix + CSS tokens)
